'''Varl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elaxis Frellka]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
During the [[Galactic War]], Varl and his men encountered the [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] who was looking for General Frellka. Varl begged the Warrior to spare him and his men while General Frellka received his alarm. The Wrath killed Varl by crushing him.
{{Endgame}}
